top_signals.title: Goldman Says Markets Too Hawkish on Betting Fed Will Hike Rates
top_signals.summary: Market bets on Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes are still too aggressive given that inflation in the world’s biggest economy is cooling, according to Goldman Sachs Group Inc.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Trump swaps planes via catering truck after Iranian threats, reports say
top_signals.summary: Trump was transferred from Air Force One to a military plane via a catering truck due to Iranian threats following a NATO summit in Turkey, reports say.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Xi Ties Predecessor’s Legacy to His Agenda as Global Risks Rise
top_signals.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping invoked the legacy of his predecessor Jiang Zemin to advance his own economic and global policy agenda, warning of “high winds and rough waters” as China faces slowing growth and rising tensions abroad.
